cases.title: the rewrite applies inside string literals
cases.note: the recorded value is the rewritten literal

cases.title: a longer name ending in a helper's is rewritten
variable, resource and flow_user_state are each awaited
a call inside another is awaited inside it
a call that ends where the next begins closes first
a parenthesis inside a string counts
a call whose parentheses never close is awaited to the end
cases.note: the reference rewrites every occurrence and does not say where an unclosed call ends; this reading closes it at the end of the text (docs/design/README.md request 8)

cases.title: JE-12 rewrites the result of JE-11
past a two-byte character the inserted ) lands a byte early, inside the string
cases.note: the position is counted in characters and applied as a byte offset (JE-11, corrected 2026-10-28, request 8); the code leaves a parenthesis open, so the source does not compile; not yet recorded (Q-JE-13)

cases.title: where the ) would land inside a character, Windmill's evaluator panics
cases.note: variable("éé") is 15 bytes and 13 characters; byte 13 is inside the second é (JE-11); what the panic does to Windmill's job is not traced (Q-JE-13), and windmill-lite fails the evaluation with its own text

cases.title: a character before the call moves the ) too
cases.note: reading: the count runs from the start of the text, which the reference's "ASCII up to the insertion point" says; a count from the call's start would give the exact position here (Q-JE-13 records only calls at the start)

cases.title: text that is ASCII up to the insertion point is rewritten exactly
an unclosed call's ) at the end of the text is counted in characters too
cases.note: reading: the rule's character count applies to the end of the text as well (Q-JE-13)
